We operate with the ethos of trust and transparency and thatmedia works best when it works in everyone’s best interest. At the very root of that, Roundel is here to drive business growth for our clients, and redefine “value” in the industry by solving core industry challenges vs. copy current industry methods of operation. We are here to drive a key growth initiative for Target and to lead the industry to a better way of operating within the media marketplace.The Account Executive, Search & Performance, Roundelworks with the world’s most recognized brands and agencies in the industry. You will be responsible for driving scalable search solutions using data and insights. You will grow your business to deliver on individual and team revenue growth with optimization and incremental sales opportunities that drive search & performance media revenue for Roundel. Your status as a trusted internal liaison coupled with the acute knowledge of performance media industry will help establish key relationships internally and externally to unlock incremental funding.Primary responsibilities include:Consult with internal partners to advance Target Product Ads capabilities and strategies, prioritizing client feedback to inform direction;Develop and implement scalable selling strategies and stories to your vertical and clients;Act as a consultant to provide solutions that deliver on client needs;Deliver impactful client presentations and education;Stay up to date on industry trends both in the performance media landscape, looking for opportunities that will deliver incremental value to clients.Partner closely with various cross-functional teams, including but not limited to Performance & Insights, Analytics, Product and Go-to-Market, to deliver and execute effective results;Provide weekly pipeline, pacing and revenue forecasts to Roundel Leadership;Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.About you:Bachelor’s degree;4+ years of performance media sales or agency experience;Proven track record of revenue growth and accountability for sales revenue of $3M+;Extensive knowledge of the performance media environment, trends/technologies, and agency landscape;Ability to think strategically, problem solve, and identify opportunities;Strong, succinct communicator that understands individual audience needs and tailors the message;Thrives in ambiguity and able to flex with changing priorities;Great partner and collaborator with cross functional teams;Must be willing to travel as necessary for maximum client and/or agency coverage.This position may be considered for a Remote or Hybrid (known internally at Target as "Flex for Your Day") work arrangement based on Target's needs. A Remote work arrangement means the team member works full-time from home or an alternate location that's not a Target location, does not have a desk at a Target location and may travel to HQ up to 4 times a year. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member's core role may be performed either remote or onsite at a Target location depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target.Benefits EligibilityPlease paste this url into your preferred browser to learn about benefits eligibility for this role: https://tgt.biz/BenefitsForYou_DAmericans with Disabilities Act (ADA)In compliance with state and federal laws, Target will make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. jobs.description: Marketing Operations Analyst – Accounts Payable - MediaAbout us:Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America’s leading retailers. Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights, and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.As a Marketing Operations Analyst, the primary purpose of this role is to support Marketing by ensuring accurate execution of marketing operational processes, invoicing, billing, maintaining related reports and documentation, and providing marketing system administrative oversight. Creatively—you’ll create work that celebrates, resonates, and helps build and maintain meaningful connections with our guest. jobs.description: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 5,000 team members powering the company’s global strategy and operations.Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.Target Creative + Contentis the in-house creative agency dedicated to bringing one of the world’s most beloved and recognizable brands to life. Whether through design, marketing or brand work, we are the driving force behind delivering Target’s dynamic, inventive and unmistakable storytelling to its massive audience.Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. Operating as one fully integrated team in both the U.S. and overseas, Target Creative + Content comprises the best and brightest talent to execute market-leading creative strategy, design, writing, video production, operations, digital, UX, social media and more. Together, we tackle every creative challenge with our amplified strengths, ultimately bearing the groundbreaking creative work that helps make Target the decisive guest favorite, year after year.Roundel, Target’s in-house retail media network, delivers impactful outcomes through curated and innovative media experiences. As part of this, Roundel Creative crafts data-driven digital advertising content tailored to strengthen the connection between leading global brands and Target guests and consumers. Leveraging Target’s deep data driven insights, Roundel creates personalized campaigns that resonate with guests, showcasing products and offers they love. Some of the renowned brands that continue to partner with Roundel include Apple, L'Oréal, Unilever, PepsiCo, Lego and many more. Learn more about Roundel here.Roundel’s growth is powered by a hybrid team of over 500 team members across the U.S. and India in areas such as Partner Solutions, Performance and Insights, Data Science, Product and Engineering teams.As an Art Director on the Roundel team, you’ll design world-class creative that drives meaningful connections between national brands and Target guests in close collaboration with a copywriter. From digital banners, social content, brand pages to key campaign visuals, you’ll develop engaging, data-driven advertising content focused on consistent design excellence.This role requires exceptional graphic design, typography, and photo art direction skills, alongside expertise in design tools and an eye for detail. You’ll stay on top of industry trends, styles, and technology to bring fresh, innovative ideas to life.Creatively, you’ll deliver work that celebrates brands, resonates with guests, and strengthens Target’s unique approach. By integrating cultural insights and a multicultural lens, you’ll strategically tailor creative solutions to connect authentically with diverse audiences, ensuring Target shows up in meaningful and memorable ways.Roles and ResponsibilitiesCraft compelling & contemporary visual ideas that align with project objectives and brand identityEnsure high-quality output across all assets both static and motionExcellent attention to detail and brand consistency. Understanding/awareness of the global culture.Adhere to structured workflow processes, timelines, , organize and plan details for multiple projects and maintain efficiencyCollaborate with copywriters, strategists, marketers, program managers to synthesise business requirements and translate them into design solutions that serve the needs of our guestsAbility to contribute individually and work well within a team. Assist the senior designers in creating design solutions.Excellent ability to communicate design thinking and effective presentation skillsThe ability to see projects through from inception to production.Personal Attributes:Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to work independently as well as follow creative directionShow passion, optimism and drive and be able to move forward in an ambiguous environmentPassionate and excited about design. Excellence in typography, color and visualStrong communication and organizational skillsThe motivation to maintain and improve design standards. The willingness to listen to feedback and use it to improveHaving a worldview & global exposureCapable of working within a fast-paced work environment and work on multiple projects at one timeStrong Creative Portfolio demonstrating breadth of type, design, and photo art direction, particularly in branding & packaging designEffective written and verbal communication skillsProficiency in all key creative software programs - Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and other design tools. Experience with Aftereffects and/or Premier Pro is a bonus.Useful Links-Life at Target-https://india.target.com/Benefits-https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits

Your ideas will support Target incomplementing the beloved in-store shopping interaction with a convenient,reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.As a Digital QA Analyst you will have an opportunity to help all guests to find theright digital products and services that bring them JOY. As part of Quality Assurance team, youwill be responsible for validating creative content, track, report and fix issues fromguest perspective, across multiple web browsers, operating systems and devices(Mobile, Tablet, Desktop). An ideal candidate should be comfortable working in acreative, fast-paced environment, focused on interpreting the creative strategyand direction.About this role:Cross functional collaboration: Fosters strong stakeholder relationshipsacross Creative, Producer and Project management teams.Retail digital acumen: Understands final creative experience, brandguidelines / style guides.Testing: Executes Category routes validations, Site refresh validations, LiveSite validations, Promotion validations, functional validations, Siteplacement launch validations.Data extraction and reporting: Owns issue log data, handles basic SQLqueries to extract periodic data for reporting.Problem solving: Data analysis, critical thinking, performs RCA and drivescorrective and preventive actions.Participates in War rooms and holds feedback sessions with stakeholders.Leverages QA expertise to uplift Site experience.About you:Graduation in Engineering / equivalent with relevant experience2+ years of E-commerce experience in Digital creative content QualityassuranceExpertise in validating creative pages / components across mobile, tabletand desktopExperience in working on creative issues / bug tracking tools (JIRA, BugZillaor equivalent)Eye for details, experience in RCA and knowledge in structured problemsolving Exceptional communication skillsFlexible to work in different time zones / weekend roasters.Adapt to new business requirements and changes.Good to have basic process automation skills, to enable process efficiencygains

**Position Purpose**The HDE Sales Manager (SM) is responsible for creating a high performing selling culture and achieve this through store connectivity, development/coaching of team, Sales Consultant staffing and delivering world class customer service. The SM will lead a team of commissioned Sales Consultants to go into the homes of Home Depot customers and successfully close the sales of HDE's product lines . The SM drives store connectivity by building and maintaining relationships with store management and associates, continually updating/training them on HDE's product offerings. The SM is also responsible for driving lead generation efforts in the stores through the sales team. The SM will manage Sales Consultants through every aspect of the employment life cycle including hiring, training/coaching, performance management, etc. The SM will lead a team of Sales Consultants to achieve sales targets for an assigned territory and will be responsible for understanding, analyzing and prioritizing business metrics (e.g., scorecards, KPI, etc). The SM is responsible for the customer experience and ensuring the sales team delivers world class customer service; this is accomplished proactively by consistently monitoring reports to ensure customer's projects are moving through the job process efficiently as well as being accountable to Voice of the Customer scores and feedback.

jobs.description:
Req161652  
  
**Position Purpose**The Sr. Data Scientist is responsible for leading data science initiatives that drive business profitability, increased efficiencies and improved customer experience. This role assists in the development of the Home Depot advanced analytics infrastructure that informs decision making. Sr. Data Scientists are expected to seek out business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage. Based on the specific data science team, this role would need to be Proficient in one or more data science specializations, such as optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP.  
  
As a Sr. Data Scientist, you will serve as a lead on data science projects, collaborating with project/product managers, providing prioritization of tasks, balancing workload and mentoring data scientists on the project team. This role is expected to present insights and recommendations to leaders and business partners and explain the benefits and impacts of the recommended solutions. This role supports the building of skilled and talented data science teams by providing input to staffing needs and participating in the recruiting and hiring process. In addition, Data Scientists collaborate with business partners and cross-functional teams, requiring effective communication skills, building relationships and partnerships, and leveraging business proficiency to solutions and recommendations.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* 35% Solution Development - Proficiently design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies; Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical leaders and business customers/partners; Prepare reports, updates and/or presentations related to progress made on a project or solution; Clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation
* 30% Project Management & Team Support - Work with project teams and business partners to determine project goals; Provide direction on prioritization of work and ensure quality of work; Provide mentoring and coaching to more junior roles to support their technical competencies; Collaborate with managers and team in the distribution of workload and resources; Support recruiting and hiring efforts for the team
* 20% Business Collaboration - Leverage extensive business knowledge into solution approach; Effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross-functional teams; Provide general education on advanced analytics to technical and non-technical business partners; Deep understanding of IT needs for the team to be successful in tackling business problems; Actively seek out new business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage
* 15% Technical Exploration & Development - Seek further knowledge on key developments within data science, technical skill sets, and additional data sources; Participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; Define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; Contribute to library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented

**Direct Manager/Direct Reports**

* This position reports to manager or above
* This position has 0 Direct Reports

**Travel Requirements**

* Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

**Physical Requirements**

* Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

**Working Conditions**

* Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must be eighteen years of age or older.
* Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PhD in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Math, Statistics, etc.)
* 6+ years of experience in business intelligence and analytics
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Power Point
* Proficient in a modern scripting language (preferably Python)
* Proficient running queries against data (preferably with Google BigQuery or SQL)
* Proficient with data visualization software (preferably Tableau)
* Mastery utilizing statistical techniques to identify key insights that help solve business problems
* Proficient in Prescriptive Modeling like optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP
* Demonstrated proficiency in predictive modeling, data mining and data analysis

**Minimum Education**

* The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.

**Preferred Education**

* No additional education

**Minimum Years Of Work Experience**

* 5

**Preferred Years Of Work Experience**

* No additional years of experience

**Minimum Leadership Experience**

* None

**Preferred Leadership Experience**

**Certifications**

* None

**Competencies**

* Attracts Top Talent: Attracting and selecting the best talent to meet current and future business needs
* Business Insight: Applying knowledge of the business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals
* Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives

**Job Description**The Home Depot Pro Customer Service/Sales Team is dedicated to delivering an exceptional experience for professional customers, including contractors, property owners, and commercial clients. **Position Purpose**A Director of Inside Sales Support leads Inside Sales Support Representatives that provides transactional and customer relationship support to the Outside Sales Representatives across managed account customers. The Inside Sales Support team focuses on activities such as quoting, order processing, and post sales fulfillment that drive customer loyalty and sales growth. The Director role is responsible for building and developing the best in class Inside Sales Support team, optimizing operational processes and productivity, managing team performance to achieve business goals and cultivating cross functional connectivity with outside sales, store and supply chain teams to ensure a seamless end to end customer experience. This role requires strong leadership, analytical thinking, a deep understanding of sales operations, and effective collaboration with both internal and external partners.

* 15% - Analytical Skills - Ability to interpret data and metrics to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Extract meaningful insights from data and industry intelligence to guide strategic decision-making. Evaluate organizational objectives and assess potential risks associated with decisions. Monitor performance metrics and implement improvements for continued success. Anticipate challenges and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.

**Position Purpose**A Home Depot Installation Services (HDIS) Design Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior and interior product and services to customers. The Design Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Design Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Design Consultants will travel to customer's homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations , develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Design Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Design Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Design Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Travel and engage in outside sales activities, primarily in customers' homes. Conduct professional and compelling sales presentations. Adapt quickly to changing customer needs and effectively advocate HDIS solutions.
* Conduct incidental activities necessary to complete sales (e.g., assessing customer needs, develop price quotes, measure product specifications, etc.)
* Present warranty and available financing options to customers. Prepare for appointments, commute to/from appointments and process sales-related paperwork.
* Prospecting for new customers both inside and outside of assigned THD store and participate in scheduled industry events. Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. **Position Purpose**The National Account Sales Rep will have responsibility for a portfolio of customers. **Position Purpose:**

A Home Depot Installation Services (HDIS) Sales Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior product and services to customers. The Sales Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Consultants will travel to customer's homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations , develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Design Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Travel and engage in outside sales activities, primarily in customers' homes. Conduct professional and compelling sales presentations. Adapt quickly to changing customer needs and effectively advocate HDIS solutions.
* Conduct incidental activities necessary to complete sales (e.g., assessing customer needs, develop price quotes, measure product specifications, etc.)
* Present warranty and available financing options to customers. Prepare for appointments, commute to/from appointments and process sales-related paperwork.
* Prospecting for new customers both inside and outside of assigned THD store and participate in scheduled industry events. Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. Attend sales and store team meetings to continually improve sales techniques and learn about HDIS product offerings.

**Direct Manager/Direct Reports:**

* This position reports to a Sales Manager
* This position has no direct reports

**Travel Requirements:**

* Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

**Working Conditions:**

* Usually in a comfortable environment but with regular exposure to factors causing moderate physical discomfort from such things as dust, fumes or odors.
* Requires regular and frequent local travel
* Access to reliable transportation will be required
* Reimbursement for travel will be available as required by state and federal law

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Must be eighteen years of age or older.
* Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3-5 years of prior in-home or virtual sales experience
* Prior home improvement industry experience
* Prior experience with successful lead generation
* Computer and application skills and use of varied technology (email, iPad, apps, etc.)

**Minimum Education:**

* The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

**Preferred Education:**

* No additional education

**Minimum Years of Work Experience:**

* 3

**Preferred Years of Work Experience:**

* No additional years of experience

**Certifications:**

* Consultants are expected to maintain 55 hours open calendar time per week (including weekends) to support customer appointments and for prospecting new customers.

jobs.description:
**Job Description****About the Role**As a Seasonal Sales Associate you provide customers with a unique shopping experience by offering excellent customer service. Utilize effective selling techniques and provide in-depth product knowledge in a fast-paced, specialty retail environment.  
  
**You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will...**

* Provide sincere, friendly and energetic customer service by exemplifying World-Class service standards
* Achieve established sales and contest goals Maintain knowledge of current sales and promotions
* Assist customers with special services including: gift wrap, gift registry, locating merchandise, catalog orders, special orders, back orders, charge sends, courier deliveries, and furniture orders
* Utilize effective selling techniques to build multiple sales and increase productivity
* Demonstrate comprehensive product knowledge, including features and benefits
* Efficiently and accurately perform register transactions i.e. sales, returns, and exchanges
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of visual merchandise presentation, signage and lighting
* Uphold store maintenance and cleanliness standards straighten, clean and help maintain stockroom as needed
* Process, ticket, and restock merchandise as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned by management
* Comply with all Company policies and procedures
* Available to work evenings and weekends

**Why you will love working at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

* We’re a successful, fast-growing company with an entrepreneurial vibe
* A technologically and data-driven business
* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits
* We’re at the forefront of tech and retail, redefining technology for the next generation
* We’re passionate about our internal and external clients and live/breathe the client experience
* We get to be creative daily
* A smart, experienced leadership team that wants to do it right and is open to new ideas
* We believe in autonomy and reward taking initiative
* We have fun!

**We’re Excited About You Because...**

* Love to sell, can articulate a proven ability to exceed selling goals & most importantly can close a sale
* Succeed in a team environment, while able to work independently & manage your own time
* Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment & are constantly looking for ways to think outside-the-box
* Know what questions to ask your customers in order to understand their personal cooking style & needs
* Enjoy discovering the customer’s style, lifestyle & story to connect them to the right products
* Most successful when provided with clearly defined daily sales goals & metrics
* High school diploma or equivalent preferred
* 1-2 years customer service experience and retail sales experience (specialty retail preferred, but not required)
* Proven ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to be mobile on the sales floor for extended periods of time, operate POS system and lift and mobilize medium to large items, (up to 75 lbs.) while utilizing appropriate equipment and safety techniques
* Full time associates are expected to have open availability to meet the needs of the business Casual associates must be available to work a minimum of two regularly scheduled shifts on the weekend (Friday, Saturday and/or Sunday) and one during the week (Monday to Thursday). Associates must be available for annual inventory and entire holiday season (November and December)
* Example: Weekend availability cannot fall on the same day; an associate must be available on two separate days (Friday and Saturday, Friday and Sunday or Saturday and Sunday) If preferred, an associate can also choose to have all three shifts of availability on the weekend (Friday to Sunday) and none during the week (Monday to Thursday)

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to be mobile on the sales floor for extended periods of time.
* Ability to operate POS system.
* Ability to lift and mobilize medium to large items, up to 75 pounds, while utilizing appropriate equipment and safety techniques

**Why join us?**Because NaughtOne don’t make furniture for your home, you probably don’t know us. But LinkedIn, Google and Adobe do – because they all have our designs in their workplaces.  
  
The NaughtOne team are just as unique as the furniture we create and if you come to work with us, you’ll be joining a global business with a Yorkshire spirit. We have colleagues all over the world because the world is our customer, but our personality reflects our home: down-to-earth, friendly and honest.  
  
We’ve received numerous accolades, including The Queens Award for Enterprise for International Trade, and that makes us proud. We’ve always cared deeply about sustainability and we’re always looking for ways to do more and have a stronger impact. We don’t do it because it’s good for business – we do it because it’s the right thing.  
  
If any of that makes you curious, good – because curious people thrive at NaughtOne. Perhaps you’ll be thriving at NaughtOne soon.  
  
**Sales Support Specialist International (UK Based)**Purpose  
  
The Sales Support role is a pivotal part of the NaughtOne International Sales Team, directly supporting our sales representative across Europe, Middle-East, Asia and Africa. This position focuses on delivering an exceptional client experience throughout the sales process by providing accurate, timely, and tailored support.  
  
You will serve as the critical link between clients, sales teams, and internal operations—ensuring that all quotations, product information, and project documentation align with client expectations and brand standards. Beyond administrative duties, you’ll play an active role in supporting regional sales growth, responding proactively to opportunities, streamlining communications, and helping to resolve project-related issues during the active selling phase.  
  
This role requires a service-oriented mindset, commercial awareness, and a keen attention to detail to uphold our commitment to client satisfaction, timely project delivery, and continued market growth.  
  
Responsibilities / Key Deliverables  
  

* Respond to client enquiries and generate priced proposal documents
* Support bids & tender submissions
* Create quotations quickly and efficiently ensuring overall accuracy
* Review client specifications, co-ordinate proposal efforts with sales team members to develop an accurate and complete solution offering which meets the client's specifications.
* Participating in customer discussions as required to provide sales support and developing an understanding of expectations in order to meet and exceed requirements to maximise the customer experience
* Provide excellent customer service as the frontline contact with our clients and provide administrative support to the sales team, enabling the team to maximise sales and improve the customer experience.
* Answering and dealing as appropriate with general sales, sales leads and queries

**Qualifications, Skills, And Experience**

* Post-secondary education preferred (A-levels, associate degree, or equivalent); strong foundational skills in English and Mathematics essential
* Proven experience in a client-facing customer service or sales support role, preferably within a design-led, B2B environment
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external partners
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with clients, understanding their needs and delivering thoughtful, responsive support
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret and communicate technical information clearly
* Proactive problem-solver with a calm, solution-focused approach to client queries and project challenges
* Technologically competent, with strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office; experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV or a similar ERP/CRM system highly desirable
* Comfortable navigating complex processes and systems with a mindset for continuous improvement
* Exceptionally organised with the ability to prioritise workload, manage multiple requests, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Empathetic and client-centric approach; committed to delivering a positive and professional experience throughout every stage of the sales process
* Self-motivated and dependable, with a strong sense of accountability and initiative

Dimension of role  
  
Based from the NaughtOne head office in Harrogate this is a permanent position reporting to the Senior Customer Experience Specialist (International). As part of a wider team of 9, the role holder will be expected to collaborate closely with the Operations function as well as the NaughtOne Sales teams.  
  
We support hybrid working. Company culture, relationships and collaboration are really important to us, so we’ll encourage you to spend the majority of your time on site.  
  
**Who We Hire?**At NaughtOne we believe in keeping things simple. So simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities – we are committed to equal opportunity employment. We honour and celebrate people's individuality, diversity and authenticity. In this inclusive environment, we thrive together, creating endless opportunities for us all to shine. Here, you can bring your whole self to work.

**Do you want to work in an international, design-driven organization with a strong global presence and the opportunity to shape long-term growth in the Nordic market? MillerKnoll is now strengthening its Nordic commercial organization and is looking for a Sales Manager responsible for the Nordic region.**

MillerKnoll is a global collective of design-led brands, formed through the merger of Herman Miller and Knoll. The organization operates across commercial and residential markets and brings together some of the world’s most influential brands within furniture and interior design.

**About the Role**

As Sales Manager – Nordic Region, you will have overall responsibility for driving sales performance across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland and Iceland. The role focuses on building strong, commercially driven relationships with designated dealers while actively developing new business opportunities with architects, designers, project management companies and end customers.

You manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to order placement and act as the primary commercial contact for assigned dealers. The role involves coordinating internal MillerKnoll resources, supporting projects throughout the sales process and ensuring high quality delivery in all customer and dealer interactions.

The position is fully remote and reports to the Head of Sales for the Nordics, Central & Eastern Europe. The role includes approximately 50% travel across the Nordic region as well as to selected European showrooms in Paris, London and Milan.

**Key Responsibilities:**

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with designated dealers and ensuring MillerKnoll is positioned as the preferred partner at all levels. A key part of the role is identifying, creating and owning sales opportunities within the territory, including responsibility for product applications, specifications, mock-ups and project solutions.

You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders such as National Account Managers, Global Enterprise Accounts, Major Projects teams, Architecture & Design, and Channel Development, contributing to both regional and global opportunities. You also provide technical and specification support to dealers in cooperation with portfolio and technical teams.

The role requires accurate forecasting, structured CRM usage and timely reporting, primarily through Salesforce. You represent MillerKnoll at regional events and fairs and are expected to deliver best-in-class presentations, proposals and tender responses, both verbally and in writing.

**Is This You?**

To succeed in this role, you have a minimum of five years’ experience in B2B sales, preferably within a complex or international organization. Experience from furniture, design or architectural products, as well as dealer-based sales models, is considered an advantage. Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM systems is beneficial. Fluency in English is required. One or more Nordic languages (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish or Icelandic) is considered a merit. A driver’s license and willingness to travel are required.

We place great emphasis on personal attributes. You are driven, methodical and energetic, with strong interpersonal and communication skills. You act with integrity, handle objections professionally and are able to balance autonomy with collaboration in an international team environment. You are comfortable working independently in a remote setup and managing a geographically broad territory. You have a structured way of working, strong commercial understanding and the ability to build trust-based relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.

**What We Offer**

At MillerKnoll, you will be part of a global, design-led organization with a strong heritage and an international presence. The company brings together some of the world’s most influential brands within furniture and interior design, operating across both commercial and residential markets.

You will join a collaborative and values-driven organization with a flat structure and accessible leadership. The role offers a high degree of autonomy and trust, combined with close collaboration with colleagues, dealers and internal stakeholders across the Nordic region and Europe. MillerKnoll provides a stable global platform while offering the opportunity to actively contribute to the continued development and growth of the Nordic market.

**Want to Know More?**

In this recruitment, MillerKnoll is collaborating with Level Recruitment. Please apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button here. For questions, please contact recruitment consultant Dennis Pater at +46 73 558 89 34. Kindly note that no applications will be accepted via email.

Selection of applications will take place continuously.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About MillerKnoll**

MillerKnoll is a global collective of design-led brands formed through the merger of Herman Miller and Knoll, operating as a unified organization with a broad international footprint and a multi-brand structure that includes well-known names such as Herman Miller, Knoll, HAY, Geiger, Maharam and Design Within Reach.

The company functions as a large, integrated corporate group with operations across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, serving both commercial and residential markets.

MillerKnoll has several thousand employees worldwide—historically in the range of 11,000–12,000 across all brands—and generates multi-billion-dollar annual revenues, reflecting its position as one of the world’s largest and most influential furniture and design companies.

The organization combines centralized leadership with brand-specific business units, enabling each label to maintain its unique identity while benefiting from shared resources, global supply chains, advanced manufacturing capabilities and a strong financial foundation.

Learn more about MillerKnoll here: https://www.millerknoll.com/about

Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

 Based in Frankfurt, Stuttgart, or somewhere centrally located between the two, to ensure convenient access to key regions.

Do you have deep connections in the design and contract industry? Do you combine a service mindset with commercial drive and strong relationship skills? And are you excited to join a world-renowned design brand?

We’re seeking a hands-on, proactive individual who combines operational excellence with strong relationship-building skills and a genuine passion for design. You’re ambitious, love to see results, and thrive as a team player.

As Area Sales Manager, you will be part of our DE Contract Sales team, reporting directly to the Contract Channel Director.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving business development across Central Germany, focusing on dealers, end-users, hospitality groups, and leading specifiers. Your primary goal will be to build and nurture long-term relationships with major dealers, corporate accounts, hotel operators, and architectural & design practices, positioning the brand as a preferred partner for large-scale contract projects.

* Deliver impactful presentations, product workshops, and showroom experiences to specifiers and clients, keeping the brand top of mind for significant projects
* Collaborate with the Contract team to enhance client engagement, host targeted events, and generate new business leads

* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of large projects from specification to delivery

* Proven track record in B2B sales within hospitality, contract furniture, interiors, or design-driven industries

* Engage in team selling by creating and owning design strategies that drive business outcomes in assigned areas

* Collaborate with dealer teams on training opportunities to ensure that they are equipped and informed on MillerKnoll healthcare insights, products, and programs
* Provide guidance on product specifications that are respectful of the clinical environment for internal teams and dealer partners
* Lead presentations and discussions related to healthcare knowledge and insights, value proposition, and programs with internal and external customers
* Coach dealer partners through the healthcare design and construction process
* Work with cross-functional teams to increase visibility and knowledge of the healthcare product portfolio

**Experience**

* Worked in Design field for 5-7 years and can work in various drawing platforms - AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, CET
* Knowledgeable about healthcare design and environments
* Managed large project through design and construction process
* Facilitated discovery and needs assessment with cross-functional teams
* Participated and worked in concert with internal and external partners to build a cohesive and productive team

Critical Skills  
  

* Creative Thinker: Create inspiring deliverables that showcase the possibilities of our product portfolio across the Healthcare floorplate
* Analytical Skills: Analysis and synthesis of information that informs programs
* High Standard of Performance: Continuous learning and growth in design field and healthcare industry that reinforce knowledge leader within internal team and with our customers
* Time Management: Able to work on multiple projects or support various initiatives engaging internal and external resources through course of business days/weeks
* Interpersonal Skills: Verbal, written, and visual communication skills that are thoughtful, respectful, and represent the MillerKnoll brand and builds trust amongst teams
* Work Ethic: Self-starter, meets deadlines, supports team
* Drawing: AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, CET
* Microsoft Office: Word, PPTX, Excel, Teams

Our Healthcare team is involved in a variety of project experiences. Each region supports healthcare in different ways. The best part of the job is working with Healthcare leaders and clinical teams to create spaces that allow for high quality patient care. Empathetic to the needs of the staff, the patient, and the families, we strive to provide solutions that support all and help create environments that encourages wellness for all. The Healthcare industry is a dynamic market segment balancing processes and outcomes with caring and passionate providers and staff who seek to bring high quality care to patients and their families. The built environment is critical to the success of delivering patient care and providing safe and productive spaces for healthcare teams.  
  
Our Values  
  
Our values speak to our shared beliefs. They describe how we live our purpose through the way we lead, the way we see one another, and the way we approach our work.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a tech-savvy, data-driven marketer to join our Integrated Marketing team as Senior Manager, Marketing Operations & Demand Generation. This is your opportunity to enhance and scale an integrated lead generation engine for our contract furniture business.

In this role, you’ll connect the dots between marketing, sales, and partner data—laying the groundwork for more precise targeting, smarter campaigns, and measurable pipeline impact. Working closely with Sales, Ecommerce, Integrated and Content Marketing, and strategic partners, you will translate customer analytics into actionable campaigns, streamline marketing processes, and advance the systems needed to generate and track qualified opportunities for our contract sales organization.

**What You’ll Do**

**Program Leadership**

* Advance and scale integrated demand generation programs that engage prospects across the customer journey.
* Strengthen processes that align Salesforce, partner databases, and customer data to inform go-to-market strategies.
* Partner with Sales leadership to optimize lead routing, follow-up cadences, and reporting.
* Collaborate with strategic partners to incorporate customer analytics into campaign targeting and account prioritization.

**Demand Generation Execution**

* Direct integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, email, and targeted ABM initiatives.
* Lead development and execution of our ABM playbook—from strategy through activation and reporting.
* Drive performance across LinkedIn Ads and other digital channels—optimizing for cost efficiency, engagement, and pipeline impact.
* Design and manage nurture programs that progress prospects through the buying journey with automated workflows.

**Marketing Operations & Measurement**

* Maintain and optimize a modern marketing systems stack that supports account identification, prioritization, and personalized campaigns.
* Implement accurate campaign tracking, attribution, and performance measurement across channels.
* Report on campaign performance weekly and monthly; develop and test strategies for continuous improvement.
* Enhance marketing processes, systems, and tools to improve efficiency, scalability, and ROI.

**Future Expansion**

* Contribute to event and field marketing strategy, integrating demand generation efforts with key industry conferences, dealer events, and MillerKnoll brand activations.
* Partner with the Director of Integrated Marketing on pipeline forecasting and growth planning.

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation, database marketing, or performance marketing (B2B experience required; contract furniture or design industry experience strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of building and launching demand generation programs from the ground up.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, CRM integrations, and data management best practices.
* Hands-on experience with paid search, paid social, ABM platforms, and campaign analytics tools.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally.
* Entrepreneurial mindset—comfortable building processes and testing approaches in an evolving environment.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

SALES MANAGER, HOSPITALITY & SPECIFIER  
 Based in London (N1 7JQ)  
   
 Do you have an established network across specifiers, dealers, and hospitality end-users? Do you have a genuine service-mindset and thrive in supporting clients, delivering solutions, and going the extra mile for customers and team members? Would you like to work for an international design company, world renowned for high quality and well-designed products?

If yes, please read on!

About the job

As Sales Manager, you will become a part of our UK Contract Sales team, and you will be reporting to our Contract Channel Director.

More specifically, your tasks will include:

Hospitality Growth & End-User Partnerships

* Drive HAY’s growth with hotel groups, operators, and large hospitality end-users.
* Build senior relationships to secure framework agreements, brand standards, and repeat business
* Identify and win new opportunities by engaging directly with developers, investors, and operators
* Lead the full sales cycle independently – from prospecting and concept engagement to project close
* Deliver tailored client presentations and position HAY as a preferred hospitality partner
* Provide ongoing service and support to ensure client satisfaction, project success, and long-term partnerships

Specifier Engagement

* Manage the UK & Ireland A&D network, building and maintaining strong relationships with key firms and contacts
* Act as a trusted partner for specifiers, providing product knowledge, project insights, and responsive service

Dealer Collaboration

* Manage day-to-day relationships with selected dealers in the contract and hospitality segment
* Support dealers with quoting, specification follow-up, and project conversion.
* Drive dealer alignment with HAY’s commercial strategy to maximize pipeline delivery

Are you the Sales Manager we are looking for?

Role expectations

* Established network across specifiers, dealers, and hospitality end-users
* Exceptionally likable, approachable, and relationship-oriented – able to build trust quickly and foster long-term partnerships
* A genuine service mindset – thrives on supporting clients, delivering solutions, and going the extra mile
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a natural ability to connect with people at all levels
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex projects simultaneously
* A proactive self-starter with strong commercial acumen, balanced by a collaborative team approach

Experience required

* Proven track record in B2B sales within hospitality, contract furniture, interiors, or design-driven industries
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); other languages are a plus
* Availability of working full-time at our London Showroom

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than Sunday 12 October 2025. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact John Cain at john\_cain@hermanmiller.com.

Who We Hire?

HAY is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.

We are seeking a tech-savvy, data-driven marketer to join our Integrated Marketing team as Senior Manager, Marketing Operations & Demand Generation. This is your opportunity to enhance and scale an integrated lead generation engine for our contract furniture business.  
  
In this role, you’ll connect the dots between marketing, sales, and partner data—laying the groundwork for more precise targeting, smarter campaigns, and measurable pipeline impact. Working closely with Sales, Ecommerce, Integrated and Content Marketing, and strategic partners, you will translate customer analytics into actionable campaigns, streamline marketing processes, and advance the systems needed to generate and track qualified opportunities for our contract sales organization.  
  
**What You’ll Do****Program Leadership**

* Advance and scale integrated demand generation programs that engage prospects across the customer journey.
* Strengthen processes that align Salesforce, partner databases, and customer data to inform go-to-market strategies.
* Partner with Sales leadership to optimize lead routing, follow-up cadences, and reporting.
* Collaborate with strategic partners to incorporate customer analytics into campaign targeting and account prioritization.

**Demand Generation Execution**

* Direct integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, email, and targeted ABM initiatives.
* Lead development and execution of our ABM playbook—from strategy through activation and reporting.
* Drive performance across LinkedIn Ads and other digital channels—optimizing for cost efficiency, engagement, and pipeline impact.
* Design and manage nurture programs that progress prospects through the buying journey with automated workflows.

**Marketing Operations & Measurement**

* Maintain and optimize a modern marketing systems stack that supports account identification, prioritization, and personalized campaigns.
* Implement accurate campaign tracking, attribution, and performance measurement across channels.
* Report on campaign performance weekly and monthly; develop and test strategies for continuous improvement.
* Enhance marketing processes, systems, and tools to improve efficiency, scalability, and ROI.

**Future Expansion**

* Contribute to event and field marketing strategy, integrating demand generation efforts with key industry conferences, dealer events, and MillerKnoll brand activations.
* Partner with the Director of Integrated Marketing on pipeline forecasting and growth planning.

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation, database marketing, or performance marketing (B2B experience required; contract furniture or design industry experience strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of building and launching demand generation programs from the ground up.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, CRM integrations, and data management best practices.
* Hands-on experience with paid search, paid social, ABM platforms, and campaign analytics tools.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally.
* Entrepreneurial mindset—comfortable building processes and testing approaches in an evolving environment.

**Job Title: Creative and Marketing Operations Project Manager Intern****Location:** New York, NY  
  
**Department:** Creative and Marketing Operations  
  
**Duration:** May 2026 – August 2026  
  
**Schedule:** Full Time  
  
**Why join us?**Our purpose is to design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. Being a part of MillerKnoll means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows MillerKnoll to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone.  
  
**About This Opportunity**MillerKnoll’s Summer Internship Program is a paid, 12-week opportunity that provides a 100% real-world experience for students early in their careers. Throughout the summer you will apply academic learning to real-world situations and cultivate leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills.  
  
This internship offers hands-on experience in project coordination, cross-functional collaboration and campaign execution within a dynamic marketing environment. The role will be responsible for assisting the Creative and Marketing Project Management Team by shepherding projects and creative deliverables through our MillerKnoll brands using our PM tool: Wrike, maintaining project timelines and the project management process across all deliverable types, including seasonal brand campaigns, in-store collateral, digital projects and social media  
  
**What You'll Do***You'll have opportunities to speak up, solve problems, influence others, and be an owner every day as you...*

* Support the Project Management Team by keeping various projects across the MillerKnoll brands on time and on track in Wrike, our P.M. software tool, adjusting timelines as needed and communicating any changes immediately to cross-functional partners.
* Support Cross-functional teams (creative, digital, content production, merchandising) with anything needed from those teams to keep projects on track.
* Attend marketing kick-off meetings to intake briefs, organize and assign projects and update timelines in accordance with each brand Project Manager.
* Develop dashboards and reports in Wrike in support of the design, editorial and content production teams.
* Proactively conceive of, define, and develop process improvements to increase efficiency and productivity across Creative and Marketing Project Management.

**What You Bring***The needed skills and experience for this role include..*.  
  

* Experience working with or on a team in a complexed and fast-paced environment.
* Basic understanding of Retail or Brand Marketing and the content these teams produce.
* Digital-first mindset with a solid understanding of eCommerce, email and social media best practices.
* Good written and verbal and communication skills.
* Proactive, self-starter with a relentlessly optimistic attitude.

**Education**

* Currently enrolled and pursuing a four-year Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or Business or a related field
* You must have a GPA of at least 3.0 (overall or within your program) to qualify for consideration in the Intern Program.

**Qualifications**

* Must be authorized to work in the US and will not require sponsorship now or in the future.
* Must be able to perform all essential functions of the position with or without accommodations

* Mentorship from experienced data professionals
* Exposure to impactful projects and business challenges
* Opportunity to develop technical and analytical skills

jobs.description:
Why join us?

Muuto is rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition characterized by enduring aesthetics, functionality, craftsmanship and an honest expression. By expanding this heritage with forward-looking materials, techniques and bold creative thinking, our ambition is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design.

Head of Sales, Middle East & Africa

You will together with our Director Sales APMEA be responsible for implementing our strategy and coordinate local adjustments for the region and carry managerial tasks for a Sales Manager reporting to you. You need to have a very good network in the A&D scene. Therefore, you should have at least 3-5 years’ experience in a local sales role and be located in Dubai.

Your responsibilities

* Develop and grow accounts in the local market to reach our sales targets for your region
* Structured development and maintenance of our network of wholesales and contract partners
* Oversee a Sales Manager for Dubai, including all managerial tasks associated
* End-to-end ownership of deals from initial contact to negotiation of terms and closing
* Sell-in and implementation of in-store solutions / new products
* Collaborate with internal teams and your sales colleagues to reach our overall growth objectives

Your profile

* Minimum 6 years’ experience as Sales or Key Account Manager in both contract and wholesale functions, ideally in the furniture market
* First experience as a people leader, including all typical managerial tasks
* Ability to act independently, self-driven and results-oriented
* Mature, credible, and comfortable in presenting in a professional environment on all levels
* Strong negotiating and closing skills, paired with effective time management
* Fluent English, understanding and speaking local languages is a plus
* Ability to travel away from home with the occurrence of odd hours

What we offer?

* A challenging job in a company in rapid growth with great opportunity for personal development
* A great work environment, characterized by entrepreneurial spirit, openness, responsibility and a sympathetic team-minded approach to problem-solving
* A full-time position based in Dubai

Responsible for sales of Edelman, Knoll Textiles, and Maharam products to a specific client roster and geography.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Travel to client locations.
* Develop ongoing relationships with clients (firms and individuals) to ensure Brand awareness, product familiarity, and ensure “first look” consideration for project involvement and specification opportunities.
* Entertainment clients by way of: meals, events, and involvement in industry functions.
* Present new Maharam products to clients specifying interior finishes via EASIER acronym.
* Handle specific product/project involvement with specifying clients, end-users, and buying customers.
* Provide product information (both aesthetic and functional) and developing strategy for pricing, navigating all delivery aspects, product suitability, and “need by” dates.

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent, degree in Interior Design is preferred.
* Sales experience preferred but not required.

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

B2B E-COMMERCE MANAGER

Based out of Horsens

Do you have proven experience in B2B e-commerce management, online self-service adoption and digital marketing? Are you a driven e-commerce professional that wish to play a pivotal role in growing HAY’s B2B online footprint? Do you want to help shape the future of how HAY partners interact with us?

If yes, please read on!

At our office facilities by the harbor edge in Horsens, you will become part of an energetic office community, consisting of approx. 100 colleagues looking forward to welcoming you to our team.

About the job

As a B2B E-Commerce Manager at HAY you are responsible for optimizing the user experience and driving sales growth on HAYB2B.com. This includes increasing self-service adoption, improving conversion rates, and enhancing basket size. The role involves customer onboarding, engagement strategies, data analysis, and collaboration with marketing, product, and tech teams. Acting as the business product owner, the role prioritizes platform improvements, ensures quality assurance, and drives marketing campaigns. Success is measured by increased digital adoption, revenue growth, and self-service adoption

More specifically, your tasks will include:

* Optimize the platform experience to boost sales, self-service adoption, and conversions
* Empower customers and sales teams through onboarding, training, and best practices
* Turn data into action by tracking KPIs and delivering insights that drive retention and growth
* Own the roadmap as business product owner, aligning with tech, marketing, and sales to launch high-impact features
* Strengthen engagement through smart B2B promotions, newsletters, and CRM initiatives

Are you the B2B E-Commerce Manager we are looking for?

Role expectations

* As a colleague, you receive positive feedback from internal teams on collaboration, project execution, and value delivery
* Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management abilities is needed in this role
* You thrive on being measured on performance within conversation rates, order values, increased platform activity, return visits, etc.
* You take decisions based on data-driven insights and reports – leading to optimization
* As our new colleague, you will become part of a community where we cherish our culture and the pace is always high – therefore it is important that you have a desire to be part of the social community that exists across departments, age groups and backgrounds

Experience required

* You have proven experience in B2B e-commerce management, UX optimization, and digital marketing
* You posses a strong understanding of analytics tools, A/B testing, and CRO methodologies
* You can manage cross-functional projects and collaborate with marketing, product, and tech teams
* If you have experience with CRM platforms and campaign automation this will be considered a plus
* You are fluent in Danish and English, both spoken and written

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV (preferably in English) as soon as possible and no later than Sunday 28 September 2025. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact John Cain at john\_cain@hermanmiller.com.

jobs.description:
Rooms To Go is looking for a Digital Graphic Designer to join our growing in-house Creative Team!  
  
As a **Digital** **Graphic Designer** working within the Digital Creative Team, you will be focused on creating graphic assets and layouts for a wide mix of multimedia projects.  
  
As part of our team of digital graphic designers, you will collaborate with all of our Marketing teams - including CRM, Content, Copy, eCommerce, Merchandising and UX/UI Development.  
  
We want someone who has a keen eye for layout, cares about esthetics & typography, and gets excited about designing something new & compelling.  
  
The ideal candidate should have multiple years' experience working with and designing/thinking in the digital space. Retail experience is obviously a plus.  
  
This candidate should have experience designing digital assets, such as web-related graphics & layouts, with a focus on mobile first and responsive design. As well as a comprehensive knowledge in the general digital creative space, with an understanding of various online marketing platforms, and experience with commonly used design tools (i.e. Adobe Suite & Figma).  
  
We want someone who is curious about what is possible with design, motion and tech. With a direct emphasis on using AI to push the boundaries and exploring what comes next.  
  
As a team contributor, we expect you to multi-task while managing multiple timelines, perform tasks effectively, develop collaborative relationships cross-functionally, and display clear communication skills while being proactive & professional.  
  
In addition, the candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own creative requests such as website initiatives, branding, website landing pages, emails, Iconography, brand development.
* Conduct competitive research, including design insights and trends.
* Participate in creative briefing, testing, and brainstorming.
* Execute daily/weekly creative requests.
* Create and maintain style guides, brand guidelines, and other design documents
* Research and stay up to date on design trends and technologies.
* Develop and implement strategies for improving design processes and workflow.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree required. Marketing/Design Major preferred.
* 1-3 years relevant work (and internship) experience.
* Proficient in Adobe Creative Suites: Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Experience with Figma.
* Motion animation and/or video editing skills is a plus.

**Core Capabilities**

* Retail and/or eCommerce experience preferred.
* Creative mindset with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Must be a team player with a strong work ethic. Works well with others.
* Flexible under time requirements and changing deadlines.
* Strong commitment to prioritization of timelines, accuracy, organization, and professionalism.
* Dedicated commitment to deliver on all project deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and accomplish tasks with minimal oversight.
* NOTE: This role is onsite 5 days a week, in our Brookhaven office.

**About Us**Founded in 1991, Rooms To Go is one of the largest and fastest growing furniture retailers in the US with over 250 stores in ten southern states, eight distribution centers and an e-commerce business. Rooms To Go offers a collaborative work environment within a supportive culture.  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Associate discounts including furniture
* Company paid life and disability insurance
* Paid time off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* And more!

Rooms To Go is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or employment against any individual on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ancestry, religion, physical or mental disability, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, or any other factor protected by anti-discrimination laws.

**Studio Art Director**The Studio Art Director is entrusted with delivering visually compelling and brand-enhancing photography and video content in collaboration with the Creative Director, overseeing projects from concept to completion. This role also encompasses maintaining established photography standards, supporting the production manager, and coordinating with the QC/post-production team to ensure effective asset management while upholding consistent, high-quality visual standards and specifications.  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Pre-Production Planning: Produce mood boards/inspiration as needed to guide the on-set team based on creative direction and strategy provided by Senior Leadership. Works with other creative team members, across multiple mediums, in the conceptualization process, beginning with the implementation stage and following through the delivery of the final product. Helping to build out model shot lists for photographers, describing actions and props. Provide room stylist insight into model wardrobe selection, while also directing Hair/Make-Up Artists on desired looks.
* On-Set Art Direction: Ensuring all photography (model/non-model) for stills and video meets brand standards by providing feedback and approving all images captured daily for Advertising Department.
* Post-Production Direction: Partner with QC/ Post-Production Team to ensure image handoffs are consistently meeting deadlines. Provides feedback to the QC/Post-Production Manager and approves final imagery prior to final upload to the DAM. Audits all image usage and ensures quality standards are being met. Gives feedback and direction to creative team members as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in an Art Director or related role.
* Experience working in the home fashion industry is preferred.
* Open communication, values keeping others informed, and ability to positively inspire teams to the highest levels of quality and performance.
* Complete fluency in Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, MS Office Suite.

**Title: Digital Content Specialist (Promotions)**   
   
 Job Type: Full-time, in person Monday - Friday   
   
 Location: Dunwoody, ATL   
   
 Department: Marketing   
   
 Report To: Director of Content   
   
 Direct Reports/Managers others: No  
   
 **Rooms To Go is looking for a Digital Content Specialist to join our growing in-house digital marketing team!**   
   
 In this role you'll get exposure to how a thriving ecommerce business operates. You'll also be working with a mix of digital marketing teams from across our organization including creative, analytics and E-commerce merchandising.   
   
 At Rooms To Go, we refer to all the things that go on our website and app as content.   
   
 As a Content Specialist, your job is to make sure that all the promotional content we put on our website and app looks the way it is supposed to, goes in the right place and when clicked takes the user to the correct page.   
   
 It is a mix of meticulous attention to detail and a thoughtful eye for design esthetics. It's a hybrid between front-end design and data entry.   
   
 To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to multitask, problem-solve, and manage multiple timelines. As a team contributor, you'll perform a range of tasks effectively, develop collaborative relationships with team members, display clear communication and act proactively.   
   
 The ideal candidate will have an interest in the digital creative and content production space and an understanding of various online marketing principles. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.  
   
 **Responsibilities:**   

* Working with our content management system, you're building and organizing web pages and mapping out future campaigns and sales events.
* Coordinating with creative, SEO, copywriting, and merchandising teams, you're acting as the liaison to get content reviewed and approved.
* Core Capabilities:
* Problem solving mindset with a high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong commitment to timelines, organization, and professionalism.
Understanding and appreciation for basic design principals.
  
   
 **Additional Capabilities:**   

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with flexible time requirements and changing deadlines.
* Acts proactively and has ability to learn new concepts quickly.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* SEO or personalization content related experience.
* Retail and/or Ecommerce experience.
* Basic HTML knowledge.
* Google Analytics certification.
A team player with the ability to work independently.
  
   
 **Required:**   

* Bachelor's degree required. Marketing/Design Major preferred.
* Relevant work or internship experience.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and web publishing.
* Microsoft Office Skills - Excel and PowerPoint preferred.
Working knowledge of Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, preferred.
